about: Reference triage for the 40 synthetic tickets, used to score models and the rules. Labelled independently by 3 reviewers on 2026-11-09 from the ticket text and the label definitions only (no current labels, rules or model output): 2 fresh Claude Opus 5.5 runs and 1 Gemini 4 Pro run (agy, Gemini 4 Argon High). The first answer in each field is the majority answer (strict scoring). The other answers are ones that at least one reviewer chose and at least two accepted (lenient scoring). All three reviewers gave the same best answer on component 40 of 40, severity 32, action 32 and runbook 39. One 3-way split (T-2054 severity) was decided by hand; its reason is in its why. Replaces the 2026-10-08 single-writer draft.
severityGuide: S1 network-wide outage or safety. S2 billing or session-data correctness, or impact across several sites. S3 one site or charger degraded. S4 question, request or cosmetic.
